research_topic: JSON Schema 2020-12 Governance, Tooling, and Type Generation Standards for Tribunus
transcript_summary: Update ADR 0020 (JSON Schema Governance) with deep research findings. The research covered JSON Schema 2020-12 spec status (IETF draft-ietf-jsonschema-json-schema-00 May 2026, $defs standard, $anchor/$dynamicAnchor, unevaluatedProperties, key diffs from draft-07), Ajv v8.20.0 (strict mode, custom formats, standalone code gen, performance), Spectral CLI v6.13.0 (custom rulesets, JSONPath+functions, CI integration), type generation tools (json-schema-to-typescript v15.0.4, quicktype v23.2.6, limitations), schema registry patterns (central index, $ref resolution, versioning strategies), governance best practices (treat-as-code, naming conventions, metadata requirements, CI pipeline), TypeScript type generation limitations (oneOf exclusivity not expressible, unevaluatedProperties no TS equivalent, if/then/else no narrowing), and OpenAPI 3.1 alignment (full 2020-12 adoption, breaking changes from 3.0). Existing gaps found: $id domain inconsistency (opencode.ai vs tribunus.dev), index.json defects (duplicate entry, missing comma, stray brace), no custom Spectral ruleset, type generation tooling uses raw npx instead of programmatic API. The enriched ADR documents all decisions, consequences, and mitigation strategies.

research_findings.title: JSON Schema 2020-12 is the De Facto Standard
research_findings.finding: JSON Schema 2020-12 is the current stable IETF spec, with draft-ietf-jsonschema-json-schema-00 seeking Proposed Standard (May 2026 — editorial/structural only, no new dialect). All major validators (Ajv v8, Spectral v6, sourcemeta) fully support it. Key changes from draft-07: definitions→$defs, $id-based referencing, $anchor/$dynamicAnchor, unevaluatedProperties/Items, if/then/else formalized, const, boolean schemas, exclusiveMin/Max as numbers. No '2026-12' release exists yet. The ecosystem has fully migrated from draft-07.

research_findings.title: Ajv v8.20.0 with Strict Mode
research_findings.finding: Ajv v8.20.0 (Apr 2026) is the current version — no v9 exists. Tribunus uses ajv@8.20.0 and ajv-cli@5.0.0. Strict mode is default since v8, detecting unknown keywords, ambiguous constructs, required-not-in-properties, tuple/type mismatches. Sub-options: strictSchema, strictNumbers, strictRequired, strictTypes, strictTuples. Formats not bundled in core since v7 — use ajv-formats. Performance best practice: compile once with ajv.compile() and reuse, allErrors:false for speed, avoid new Ajv() in hot paths. Standalone code generation available for serverless.

research_findings.title: Spectral CLI v6.13.0 for Schema Linting
research_findings.finding: Spectral is an open-source JSON/YAML linter using ajv internally. Tribunus uses @stoplight/spectral-cli@6.13.0. Built-in rulesets: spectral:oas, spectral:asyncapi. Custom rulesets defined in .spectral.js or .spectral.yaml — rules use JSONPath + custom JS/TS functions. Supports error/warning/info severity. Distributable via Git, npm, or URLs. CI integration via stoplightio/spectral-action GitHub Action. No custom Spectral ruleset currently exists to enforce ADR 0020 conventions — CI calls Spectral with defaults only.

research_findings.title: Type Generation: json-schema-to-typescript v15.0.4
research_findings.finding: json-schema-to-typescript v15.0.4 (Jan 2025) is the primary type generation tool. TypeScript-only, no runtime. allOf→intersection (&), oneOf/anyOf→union (|), $ref/$defs resolved via $RefParser, enums supported. Options: tsType, tsEnumNames, additionalProperties control. Lighter fork: json-schema-to-typescript-lite@15.0.0. Programmatic API recommended over bare npx CLI for error handling and config control. Known limitations: oneOf exclusivity NOT expressible in TS (union is inclusive OR), unevaluatedProperties has no TS equivalent, patternProperties→index signature loses regex, if/then/else requires manual narrowing, $dynamicRef poorly supported. quicktype v23.2.6 is an alternative for complex oneOf/anyOf patterns — multi-language, handles type inference from JSON samples, heavier footprint.

research_findings.title: Schema Registry: Central Index with $id-Embedded Versioning
research_findings.finding: The schemas/index.json registry pattern is already implemented and is the correct approach. Best practice: absolute $id URIs (https://tribunus.dev/schemas/...) with $ref resolving via full URI + JSON Pointer. Ajv supports this via addSchema() then getSchema(). Three versioning strategies exist: (1) $id-embedded (best) — https://tribunus.dev/schemas/roadmap/v1/roadmap.json; (2) directory-based: schemas/v1/; (3) data-instance version field. SemVer: major=breaking, minor=compatible additions, patch=fixes. Known defects in the current index: $id uses opencode.ai not tribunus.dev, duplicate builder_publication_record entry, missing comma before roadmap, index defines its schema inline vs using defs.json $defs.

research_findings.title: Schema Governance: Treat as Code
research_findings.finding: Schemas must be treated as code: version control, linting, formatting, code review, testing. CI gate rejects non-compliant schemas. Three-stage CI pipeline: (1) pre-commit: syntax lint + format; (2) CI push: ajv meta-schema + Spectral ruleset; (3) CI merge: type generation + typecheck. Naming conventions: properties camelCase, arrays plural, booleans never null, files kebab-case.schema.json, definitions PascalCase. Metadata REQUIRED: $schema, $id, title, description. SHOULD: examples, default, deprecated. Custom x- prefix acceptable. ADR 0020 already defines these but they are not enforced by tooling — no custom Spectral ruleset exists.

research_findings.title: OpenAPI 3.1 Fully Adopts JSON Schema 2020-12
research_findings.finding: OpenAPI 3.1 fully adopts JSON Schema 2020-12 as the schema language — any valid 2020-12 schema is valid in OpenAPI 3.1. Breaking changes from 3.0: nullable REMOVED (use type: ['string', 'null']), discriminator changed, example deprecated (use examples plural array), exclusiveMin/Max now numeric, format is non-validating annotation. New capabilities from 2020-12 in OpenAPI: if/then/else, patternProperties, prefixItems, $defs, $anchor, unevaluatedProperties, boolean schemas, const. $schema keyword within Schema Objects for dialect declaration. Tribunus schemas are standalone 2020-12 (not embedded in OpenAPI) but alignment enables future reuse.

research_findings.title: TypeScript Type Generation Limitations
research_findings.finding: allOf directly maps to TS intersection (&) — good for simple object merges but contradictory constraints produce valid TS while runtime validation fails. oneOf/anyOf both map to TS union (|) — oneOf exclusivity NOT expressible, most generators treat them identically. Internal $ref: generators inline referenced type. External: all schemas resolvable via $RefParser. $dynamicRef poorly supported — manual types needed. No TS equivalent for: unevaluatedProperties, patternProperties (degrades to index signature losing regex), if/then/else (manual narrowing needed), format constraints (email, uri), enum numeric/string mapping may be suboptimal.
